Caveat: peer multiples were pulled from a live data source reflecting the retrieval date, not necessarily synchronized to the dossier's 2026-09-25 valuation date or fiscal periods; peers differ materially in growth/margin profile (SHOP high-growth, TCX small-cap/negative FCF, WIX turnaround), so this is a directional corroboration, not a precise fair-value estimate.
